post.description: Validate current credentials and rate limits on every attempt. Revoke prior presented preauth/authenticated session and rotate session plus CSRF. Never cache or reissue Set-Cookie or a previously issued secret. A lost reply requires fresh CSRF bootstrap and credential validation; any unreachable session expires normally. Revocation is monotonic. Idempotency-Key is rejected with 400; no business receipt, credential fingerprint or cached authentication response. Require session-bound CSRF, validated same-origin request and bounded rate limits. Serialize session issuance with password reset/account suspension; recheck current credential version and user state at commit so in-flight old-password login cannot survive reset.

post.summary: Revoke current session, expire cookies, signal local-vault purge.
post.description: CSRF-protected monotonic revocation; clear cookie and request local-vault purge. Active/preauth or recognized revoked/expired verifier may authorize only this cleanup, never business access. Repeated cleanup succeeds without issuing a session. After cookie clearing bootstrap fresh preauth CSRF for another cleanup; unrecognized cookie fails authentication. Idempotency-Key is rejected with 400; no business receipt, credential fingerprint or cached authentication response. Require session-bound CSRF, validated same-origin request and bounded rate limits.
